svg.aria-label: Two dot charts on one time axis, by 25-year period from 1600 to 1974, medians per 1,000 words. Semicolons fall from 10.1 in 1775-99 to 4.6 in 1900-24 and 1.8 in 1950-74, with the steepest fall after 1825. Commas, above for scale, fall less: from 85.9 to 63.1 over the same periods. Periods before 1775 have fewer than 20 books each and are drawn hollow.
svg.text: SEMICOLONS FALL FROM 10 TO 2 PER 1,000 WORDS
Hollow dots: periods with fewer than 20 books, left out of the numbers in the text
